title: Going back to my roots - RICHIE HAVENS

lines.l: I'm talking about the roots in the land
I'm holding down, got my head turned around
I can't live with nobody else
Who's living in a world of fantasy Going back, going back where I can be me
I'm searching for riches I've had all the time Finding out happiness is just a state of mind
To the place of my birth
I'm talkin' about the roots in the land
I'm talkin' about the roots in the land, yeah
I'm home without my head to ground
Going home, going home where I do belong
I've found the riches and I've got the time
Finding out happiness with just a little mind
To the flames of my breath
Get out there to the end
It's not black, it's not white
It's not red, it's not yellow
